data_manifest.citation: Taormina et al., The Battle Of The Attack Detection Algorithms: Disclosing Cyber Attacks On Water Distribution Networks, Journal of Water Resources Planning and Management, 144(8), 2018.
data_manifest.labels: Dataset03 is normal-only; Dataset04 contains ATT_FLAG=1 approximate attack labels and ATT_FLAG=-999 unknown rows.

protocol.unknown_handling: ATT_FLAG=-999 is masked from test-negative, precision, FPR, and F1 metrics
protocol.capability: analyst-declared channel-prefix group budgets; no labels passed to explanation generation
protocol.support: validation-normal q95 distance to 256 sampled normal training references; empirical proxy only
